output.reason: The linked issue [ev-1f36a8a0cff8][ev-aff821af2846] names the setting (controller.resource.health.persist in argocd-cmd-params-cm, old default "true", health stored in the Application CR) and proposes flipping it so health is persisted in Redis instead. The release note [ev-184bc27865b1] and PR title [ev-f5e511ff2cfe] confirm the default flipped in 3.0, and the PR touched argocd-cmd-params-cm docs and the 2.14-3.0 upgrade guide [ev-067a10dcca47]. Installations that don't set the key are exposed: resource health is no longer written to the Application CR, which the issue says affects tools that read the Application CRD directly. Confidence is low because the key and its defaults come from the issue, not the merged PR or the upgrade-guide text.
